preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained owner privileges)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the blacklistAddress() function with any contract address and set value to true. This will prevent that contract from making any transactions (transfers) with the INCOME token, effectively stopping its operations. The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily block contracts from transacting.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The INCOME contract has a blacklistAddress() function that is only callable by the owner. This function can arbitrarily blacklist any address, preventing it from sending or receiving tokens. This demonstrates owner privilege abuse where the owner can censor any address from using the token.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call blacklistAddress() to blacklist a target contract address, then verify the blacklist status.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address of the INCOME contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call blacklistAddress() with a target contract address (e.g., WBNB) and value=true. 4. Verify that _isBlacklisted[targetAddress] returns true.
